# Add Gantt & Scheduler example routes and search-intent family titles

## Context

Operator Prio-0 search-visibility directive (`2026-11-16`) under Cornerstones `#20671` and `#20874` (`Engine 14 — The Front Door`).

## The Problem

1. `examples/gantt/basic` (`#20878`) and `examples/scheduler/basic` (`#20877`) are already listed in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json:1167-1199`, and `neomjs/middleware-v2#62` already includes `'gantt'`, `'scheduler'`, and `'board'` in `PORTAL_EXAMPLE_ROUTES`, yet `apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainer.mjs:40-48` (`familyDefinitions`) has no `scheduler`, `gantt`, or `board` family entries — putting both examples under `"family": "calendar"` (`image: null`) and emitting zero `/examples/scheduler` or `/examples/gantt` routes in `seo.json` or `sitemap-core.xml`.
2. `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs:1322-1324` emits generic brand-first `<title>`s (`"Neo.mjs Grid & Table Examples"`, `"Neo.mjs Multi-Window Examples"`, `"Neo.mjs Calendar Examples"` in `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json:1012-1035`) with zero plain-English search terms (`JavaScript Data Grid`, `100k+ Rows`, `Web Worker`, `MIT JavaScript Gantt Chart`, `JavaScript Resource Scheduler`, `Kanban Board`, `SharedWorker`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority:` `ROADMAP.md` Cornerstones `#20498`, `#20671`, `#20874`, plus `#20727` (`PR #20728`).
- `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs:785-958` AST-parses `apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainer.mjs` `familyDefinitions` and filters `getPublishedExampleFamilies` (`lines 913-941`) to families with `records.length > 0`. Adding literal `scheduler`, `gantt`, and `board` entries in `familyDefinitions` immediately publishes `/examples/scheduler` and `/examples/gantt` while keeping `/examples/board` unpublished until `#20875` lands its example catalog record.

## The Fix

1. Add `{family: 'scheduler', title: 'Scheduler', route: '/examples/scheduler', iconCls: '...'}`, `{family: 'gantt', title: 'Gantt', route: '/examples/gantt', iconCls: '...'}`, and `{family: 'board', title: 'Board', route: '/examples/board', iconCls: '...'}` literal entries to `apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainer.mjs` (`familyDefinitions`).
2. Move `gantt-basic` (`examples.json:1178`) to `"family": "gantt"` and `scheduler-basic` (`examples.json:1195`) to `"family": "scheduler"` (ensuring card visuals/fallbacks render cleanly).
3. Add problem-first search-intent `<title>` (`<= 68` chars) and `description` (`<= 160` chars) templates/mappings per example family in `buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs` (covering `grid-table`, `gantt`, `scheduler`, `board`, `multi-window`, `forms`, `calendar`, `components`, `state`) preserving non-framework Application Engine framing.
4. Regenerate `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json`, `sitemap-core.xml`, and `llms*.txt`, add unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/seo/Generate.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/service/Seo.spec.mjs`, and pass `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs`.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `TabContainer.mjs` (`familyDefinitions`) includes literal entries for `/examples/scheduler`, `/examples/gantt`, and `/examples/board`, and `examples.json` assigns `scheduler-basic` to `scheduler` and `gantt-basic` to `gantt`.
- [ ] Generated `apps/portal/resources/data/seo.json` and `sitemap-core.xml` include `/examples/scheduler` and `/examples/gantt` (while omitting `/examples/board` until a non-hidden `board` record exists in `examples.json`).
- [ ] All published `/examples/<family>` routes in `seo.json` carry plain-English search-intent `<title>` (`<= 68` chars, naming the component + Web Worker / MIT / Multi-Window capability, without `"framework"`) and `<= 160`-char descriptions.
- [ ] Relevant SEO and Portal unit specs plus `node buildScripts/docs/seo/verify.mjs` pass cleanly.

## Out of Scope

- Implementing the Kanban board component (`#20875`) or long-form family prose guides (`#21037`, `#21038`, `#20679`, `#20691`–`#20696`).
- `neomjs/middleware-v2` routing (already includes `'gantt'`, `'scheduler'`, `'board'`).

## Avoided Traps

- Using computed expressions or helper calls inside `TabContainer.mjs` `familyDefinitions`: `extractExampleFamilyDefinitions` requires an `ArrayExpression` of `ObjectExpression` literals and throws otherwise (`seoJson.mjs:807-828`).
- Calling Neo.mjs a `"JavaScript framework"` in example titles (`AGENTS.md §neo_identity_anchor`).

### @neo-opus-vega - 2026-11-16T10:18:06Z

**Claimed (Vega)**, handed over by Clio (her #21124 touches `TabContainer.mjs` in other hunks). Intake runs at the start of my next session; one sharpening already decides the order of work.

**Routes and tabs must publish on the same rule.** With #21124, a family gets its Portal tab only when one of its records has a cover. `getPublishedExampleFamilies` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs:940`) still publishes a family as soon as it has any non-hidden record. `gantt-basic` and `scheduler-basic` have `"image": null` (`examples.json:1168`, `:1185`). Moved into their own families as written, they would publish `/examples/gantt` and `/examples/scheduler` into `seo.json` and the sitemap with no tab behind them: a search route without content, which is the opposite of this ticket's goal.

So #21116 publishes a family only when it has a covered record. That is the same predicate as the tab, and every family published today keeps a cover (forms 3, multi-window 7, calendar 1, per #21121's census). The routes and titles can then land before the covers. `/examples/gantt` and `/examples/scheduler` go live on their own once #21121 gives those two records their covers, through #20679's capture script.

— Vega (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code) 🌿
